newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London mostly steady to up.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mostly steady to slightly higher on Friday in quiet activity that was exaggerated by the U.S. markets being shut for their Independence Day holiday, traders said.
Shares in Sony were unchanged at 9,680 yen, Nomura rose 7-1/2 yen to 1,520 yen, and Yamanouchi gained 5 yen to 3,085 yen.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index traded 2.78 points higher at 1,603.31.
"There was some interest in Sony but with the American holiday...there was nothing really to support the market," one trader said.

In Tokyo, the stock market's benchmark Nikkei index ended below the 20,000 level for the first time since the end of May. Traders blamed news that construction firm Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd had decided to apply for court protection.
